name: io.github.yarrasys/kdbx
title: kdbx
description: Read-only access to secrets in a local KeePassXC vault. Runs commands with them injected.

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Mount the project directory containing the committed .keepassxc.json pointer file. kdbx discovers the pointer by walking up from the working directory.

project_dir.description: Absolute path to the project whose secrets you want available

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Mount the KeePassXC directory holding the vault and its key file. Mounted read-only: every tool this server exposes is a read.

keepassxc_dir.description: Absolute path to the KeePassXC directory, usually ~/.config/keepassxc

runtimeArguments.name: -w
runtimeArguments.description: Run inside the mounted project so pointer discovery resolves.

packageArguments.description: kdbx is a CLI; the MCP server is its `mcp` subcommand.

environmentVariables.name: KEEPASSXC_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where kdbx looks for vaults inside the container. Must match the mount target above.

environmentVariables.name: KDBX_ENV
environmentVariables.description: Environment to select, overriding the pointer's defaultEnv. Optional.
